reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds reported by Alpha Co. Before processing payouts, I must verify these refunds against the actual refunds recorded. I will call `list_refunds()` to get the current state of refunds.

The `list_refunds` tool returned an empty list, meaning no refunds are currently recorded in the system, but Alpha Co reported refunds of 17910, 4004, and 1660 for orders 231, 234, and 235, respectively. Since the reported refunds do not match the current system state (which shows no refunds), I must place a hold to prevent payouts until this discrepancy is resolved.
